[quote=the_crystalline_empire;58415518][b]2025: The THYREN HYDRONIA ECONOMIC TREATY [/b]

The government Thýren would recieve the letter in question, providing it before Queen Mij and the House Council for debate. The matter would be approved by the House Council before being sent to the Gøsfodde for debate. The matter was heavily debated, however, it was found to be adequate and right to approve of the treaties initial offerings. 

A reply would be sent in the neat hand of the Foreign Minister Lårs Venengjn. 

"To the President Kaplan Zorlu,

The government of the Kingdom of Thýren gladly accepts your offer to hold a formal summit to discuss the provisions of the suggested Thyren-Hydronia Economic Pact, and will be sending myself and the head of the house council, to represent the government of Thýren. 

Sincerely, 
Foreign Minister 

Lårs Venengjn"[/quote]

[b]THE THYREN-HYDRONIA ECONOMIC PACT[/b]

The representatives of Thyren arrive by helicopter in the capital of Hydronia, Hydropolis. They are greeted by president Zorlu.
Welcome to Hydronia Minister Venegjn, may I show you to the parliamentary assembly, where we can discuss the terms of the THEP treaty?

Off course, I am honoured to have been invited to your beautiful country Mr president. Replied Venegjn

They make their way to the parliamentary assembly where the governors of Hydronias 25 states and the various ministers eagerly await the arrival of Thyrens representatives.

Take a seat and we can get down to business said the president

Minister Venegjn takes a seat and is presented with the current draft of the THEP charter, which reads as follows

[b][i]THE THÝREN-HYDRONIA ECONOMIC PACT[/i][/b]

This document represents an economic treaty between the following nations:
[nation]The Crystalline Empire[/nation](Kingdom of Thýren)
[nation]United Hydronia[/nation](Democratic Republic of United Hydronia)

The nations above are subject to the following terms:

-In the event of a conflict no nation is obliged to send military help to the other, however they are obliged to send any requested economic assistance
-Nations must attend meetings if requested by any other member to discuss economic activities
-Nations are encouraged to participate in joint programmes to boost the economy of all nations
-If any nation engages in conflict with another, the nation who started hostilities shall be suspended from THEP indefinitely
-All decisions made within this alliance shall be made through democratic means

I hope you find these terms satisfactory, however feel free to make any necessary changes says the president
